config.script:
connectionName = "SiemensPlc"
    
    objectId = "nsu=http://agratas.com/UA/;s=IN11.E115.PRO.CMIX101/AGMethods"
    methodId = "nsu=http://agratas.com/UA/;s=IN11.E115.PRO.CMIX101/AGMethods/SetRecipe"
    
    header = {
        "ProcessStep": "STEP1",
        "ProductionOrder": "PO-12345",
        "Version": "V1"
    }
    
    p0 = {
        "ParameterRef": "Param_001",
        "ParameterType": "Temperature",
        "ParameterUOM": "degC",
        "USL": 60.0,
        "LSL": 40.0,
        "Setpoint": 45.0
    }
    
    p1 = {
        "ParameterRef": "Param_002",
        "ParameterType": "Speed",
        "ParameterUOM": "RPM",
        "USL": 1500.0,
        "LSL": 500.0,
        "Setpoint": 1000.0
    }
    
    # Convert parameter list to JSON string
    parameterArray = system.util.jsonEncode([p0, p1])
    
    inputs = [header, parameterArray]
    
    try:
        callStatus, inputStatuses, outputs = system.opcua.callMethod(
            connectionName,
            objectId,
            methodId,
            inputs
        )
    
        system.perspective.print("Call Status: {}".format(callStatus))
        system.perspective.print("Input Statuses: {}".format(inputStatuses))
        system.perspective.print("Outputs: {}".format(outputs))
    
    except Exception as e:
        system.perspective.print("OPC UA Method Call Failed:")
        system.perspective.print(str(e))
